fold: Settlement cannot cover ~# lbs of food per day (#% of needs) and has no dependable trade route.
text: Settlement cannot cover ~3512 lbs of food per day (46% of needs) and has no dependable trade route.
why: Gives shortfall ~3512 lbs (46%), which counts 2151 imports; the Food Security panel says no food comes in by trade and short is 5,663

fold: What is already in store is all there will be until it lifts.
text: What is already in store is all there will be until it lifts.
why: 'stored food is all there will be'; FOOD shows 8% grown and 28% made by magic, and C9893 says what is still harvested stretches stores

fold: What is already in store is all there will be until it lifts.
text: What is already in store is all there will be until it lifts.
why: "What is in store is all there will be": FOOD has 14% grown and 56% by magic daily (12,596 lbs/day); C19352 says what is harvested stretches the store

fold: No single dominant organisation: just the steady pressure of too many people with too little, and too few consequences for taking.
text: No single dominant organisation: just the steady pressure of too many people with too little, and too few consequences for taking.
why: says 'no single dominant organisation' in crime; page says one syndicate controls the criminal hierarchy and decides what crime is allowed

fold: A court exists, though there is nowhere to hold the guilty.
text: A court exists, though there is nowhere to hold the guilty.
why: 'nowhere to hold the guilty' (also C30860, C30935) vs Commander's secret of a prisoner who died 'in the cells'

fold: Ask who runs crime here and the answer is # ring.
text: Ask who runs crime here and the answer is one ring.
why: 'the answer is one ring' (one syndicate) but HOUSES has Multiple criminal factions and Rival gangs 'several gangs at odds'

fold: The constant monster threat keeps the guard exceptionally well-drilled and alert.
text: The constant monster threat keeps the guard exceptionally well-drilled and alert.
why: calls the guard exceptionally well-drilled; the citizen militia is part-time volunteers with no training or command

fold: The walls leave few ways in, and the guard watches them.
text: The walls leave few ways in, and the guard watches them.
why: says the guard watches the ways in; DEFENCE watch none, garrison none, only a citizen militia; C55201 says the palisade has no gate
